**CASTING CALL - NEW SHOW AT WYNN LAS VEGAS!** 

**Wynn Las Vegas is seeking trained male and female dancers, aerialists with dance skills, and dancers with aerial experience** 

**Contracts begin February 2027**

**OPEN CALLS - NO PRE-REGISTRATION REQUIRED**

**NORTH HOLLYWOOD, CA**
Friday, October 23, 2026
Mihran K. NoHo
5437 Satsuma Avenue

North Hollywood, CA 91601

**LAS VEGAS / HENDERSON, NV**
Saturday, October 24, 2026
The Stage
2510 Anthem Village Drive, #150

Henderson, NV 89052

**AUDITION SCHEDULE - BOTH LOCATIONS**
* **Men:** 10:00 AM (sign-in begins at 9:30 AM)
* **Women:** 1:30 PM (sign-in begins at 1:00 PM)

**CALLBACKS:** Sunday, October 25, 2026, in Las Vegas

**WHAT TO BRING & WEAR**
• Resume and headshot
• Sneakers or flat dance shoes
• Form-fitting clothing that clearly shows your body lines and silhouette. Please avoid baggy clothing.

**IMPORTANT INFORMATION**
• All performers, including aerialists, must participate in the initial movement/dance audition.
• Aerial evaluations will take place separately at another location and date.
• All applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
• Must be 21 years of age or older to audition.
• This is a non-union production.

FROM FIRST CLASS TO BUSY WORKING ACTOR! 

You probably recognize RYAN O’NEIL — a talented, dedicated actor turning his passion into a successful career!

Back in 2024, Ryan walked into my studio with ZERO acting experience, a big heart, natural talent, and a mega-ton of energy and enthusiasm!
Through my Certificate Program, he developed his skills, confidence, and professionalism. After graduating, I referred him to talent agents. He secured representation, started booking roles, he’s proud to have hosted the 2026 Toronto Shorts Independent Film Festival, and recently joined ACTRA!

Now, as an actor with 140 principal roles booked, two acting award wins, and recognition from Roku, Ryan knows firsthand what it takes to work in this industry.

Last week, Ryan returned to my Thursday Night Scene-Study Class to share his experiences and industry insights with my current students. ❤️

THIS is why I do what I do! Talent is a start. Training, commitment, and courage can take you further.

READY TO TAKE YOUR FIRST STEP?
Whether you're a beginner or ready to take your acting to the next level, come train with us at bongo productions Acting Studio!

Message me about our Certificate Program and Thursday Night Scene-Study Class.

Your journey toward becoming a working actor could start here!

Your coach, Michael Caruana

EXTRAORDINARY PERFORMERS WANTED
KYOTO, JAPAN

SVENGALI – THE HOUSE OF CURIOSITIES is looking for extraordinary circus and variety performers to join our unusual world in Kyoto, Japan.

We are an intimate, immersive cabaret where the strange, the beautiful and the unexpected come together.

With an audience of only 35 guests, every performance is close, personal and unforgettable.

We are especially interested in:

* Aerial performers (silks, straps, hoop, hair suspension)

* Sword swallowing and unusual sideshow acts

* Contortionists

* Contact juggling and extraordinary object manipulation

* Unusual balancing acts

* Strange, original and visually captivating performances

We are looking for artists with strong personalities, unique skills and a passion for creating something truly different.

Svengali operates five nights a week, and we are looking for performers interested in joining us in Kyoto.

Applicants must be eligible for a Japanese Working Holiday Visa.

Interested?

Send us a message on Instagram @svengali_kyoto, including a short introduction and videos of your performances.

Come and become part of our strange little world.

EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED.

items.text:
Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Web Series
Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Poszukujemy Statystów w wieku 18-70 lat (kobiety i mężczyzn) z Kielc lub okolic na plan zdjęciowy do spotu reklamowego dla znanej sieci restauracji w Kielcach w dniach 3.11, lub 4.11 (wtorek lub środa).

1. Zdjęcia w plenerze. Nagrania późnym popołudniem do nocy.

2. Wynagrodzenie za 1 dzień zdjęciowy: 150 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po planie zdjęciowym — BLIK na numer telefonu/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania i dostępności w dniach 3.11 lub 4.11 prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy

5. Adres e-mail

6. Wzrost

7. Czy jest Pan/Pani dostępna/y w terminie 3.11-4.11?

8. Link do swojego profilu na Facebook/Instagram

9. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Plan zdjęciowy Kielce

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w planie zdjęciowym zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

Looking for an **older man or woman (55–85+)** with a distinctive, interesting face and strong screen presence for an independent music video shooting in London on **Tuesday 27 October**.

**No dialogue or previous acting experience necessary**, but we're looking for someone comfortable on camera who can bring a lot of character through subtle expressions.

📅 **Shoot:** 27 October, one day
💰 **Micro-budget / collaborative project** — expenses and catering provided.

If interested, please send a few recent photos, your age, and any acting experience/showreel (if available) to:

📩 **[plebias@gmail.com](mailto:plebias@gmail.com)** (Producer — Gabe)

Thanks so much! 🙏

Hello all! Happy spooky season. We at Birnamwood Productions are filming a fun, short music video on the weekend of November 7 + 8, looking for cast and crew who want to use their Halloween costumes just a little bit longer. Using the song F.a.S.T by local artist Seattle Kaye, we’re aiming for a Thriller-esque short of an oblivious pizza guy who delivers to a haunted house, puts on his headphones, and then dances unwittingly through a bunch of monsters trying to eat him. 

The location is in the Calhan area, and it will be an overnight shoot.

**Title:** Special Delivery

**Logline:** An oblivious pizza driver delivers a pizza in an obviously haunted house.

**Length:** 2-3 minutes, should be done in a single shoot day.

We’re looking for actors and costumes that lean toward biohazard, zombie, or alien aesthetics. We will have a stunt coordinator on site, so if you haven’t ever worked stunts before, this is a great time to learn. 

We are also casting one person for Oblivious Pizza Guy to dance through the haunted house ― if auditioning for that role, please include a clip of yourself dancing to F.a.S.T by Seattle Kaye.

We are also on the hunt for an ART DIRECTOR, so if you’re available, have experience with horror, and want to go all out for a silly horror comedy, be sure to let us know!

Casting Call link: 

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfF8C584mNbWj05bAOH4H0H3y6Yiv7FXlyGkVRceQvUOHW6Sg/viewform?usp=publish-editor](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfF8C584mNbWj05bAOH4H0H3y6Yiv7FXlyGkVRceQvUOHW6Sg/viewform?usp=publish-editor)

Hope to hear from you soon!

sharedPost.text:
**Casting Call - Don't Go Yet **

Logline/Genre - Don’t Go Yet is a short film and passion project of mine. It is a dark dramedy focused on a pair of best friends Adam and Connor. When Adam walks in on a failed suicide attempt by Connor, he persuades him to give twenty-four hours to convince him life is worth living. If he fails, Connor may go through with the suicide with no interruption.

Dates and Locations – Dates have been nailed down but we are aiming for two to three weekends of shooting at the end of October/beginning of November. Locations are close to being locked in with one in Wheat Ridge and the other in Westminster.

Director – Cody Pape

Director of Photography – Alex Sistare

Compensation – The two leads will be paid $150 - $200 a day. Rest of the cast will be unpaid. Snacks and meals will be provided on all shoot days. You’ll also receive credit for the film.

Union Status – Non-union

Audition information - If interested please email [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) with the subject line “Don’t Go Yet – Your Name” with head shots, reels and any other applicable material and I will send sides in response. Once we have dates locked, we plan to hold in-person auditions for the two leads and most of the supporting cast.

Project Notes –** **Please note that this project contains heavy drug use and acts of suicide and self-harm.

**Characters**

Connor – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A scrawny, handsome but unkept male that has lost all excitement about life. A small number of tattoos is preferred but not a requirement. He was once a very loving, outgoing person loved by many before everyone around him started to grow up. He refuses to make changes in his life due to the effort required to make them. Contact with close friends has depleted and he hasn’t been on a date in years. The only consistent thing in his life that brings him genuine joy is his best friend, Adam. He’s not miserable but he’s not happy. He’s done with the monotony of existing.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging, plastic bag over the head and prat falls are included in this role.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Adam – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) - Adam is an average height; muscular man covered in tattoos with a smile they would use in a toothpaste advertisement. It's not mentioned that he is ex-military, but his appearance would suggest he served. He has a handful of extremely close relationships with men in his life but dates a new woman every month. He is the epitome of toxic masculinity and has no idea how to express himself. All feelings and emotions are under lock and key except when it comes to Connor who has access at times.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Alec – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – College buddy of Connor’s. Smaller in size. Timid and has trouble sticking up for himself. Is always in the circle but has trouble getting a word in.

Amanda – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – A mutual friend of Adam and Connor’s. What once was an extremely important platonic friendship for Connor who could come to Amanda with any problem and get the support needed has become something distant to the point that Amanda has given up on the friendship. She is energetic, bubbly and can be a little bit of a steamroller in conversation. She finds it easy to give relationship advice but can’t figure out why she hasn’t found Mr. Right yet.

Gabe – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male or female (any race) – Connor and Adam’s old guitar player in a band that was taking off before Connor decided to self-sabotage the success. Gabe doesn’t hold any resentment. He lives in the moment at all times and couldn’t bother himself with what happened yesterday or the events of tomorrow.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Greg – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A high school friend of Connor and Adam’s. The starting quarterback that had all eyes on him on and off the field has had trouble accepting that time of his life is no longer around. He doesn’t have a lot going on upstairs. He assumed his body would take him places until laziness and beer took that from him. He is large and in charge in conversation and physical appearance. He picks on those smaller than him, projecting his own pain but is also quite oblivious to anyone’s feelings but his own.

Hailey – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – Connor’s ex-girlfriend. To Connor, Hailey is the one that got away. They’re not together for many reasons but when they look at each other, there is an unspoken agreement that they will try again at some point. Hailey is the struggling artist that has it all figured out on the outside but due to past trauma can’t seem to give herself over to anyone once it becomes serious. Indie, alternative, mildly goth aesthetic. Piercings and tattoos are encouraged.

Tim – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Amanda’s new boyfriend that give’s Connor some perspective on life. Tim is a counterweight to Amanda’s energy and appears to be the answer to her prayers. You can tell they’re madly in love by the synchronicity of their laughter.

Vinny – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Singer or Guitar player of Adam and Connor’s old band. He was also Connor’s closest friend aside from Adam. He’s gone on with the band’s name with new members and is seeing the success that Connor always dreamed of. Both Connor and Vinny hold resentment towards each other. Vinny see’s Connor as wasted potential while Connor sees him as a sellout.

Preferred skills
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Look forward to hearing from you!

Do najnowszego odcinka Trudnych Spraw, poszukiwani MĘŻCZYŹNI:

1.MARCEL GŁOWACKI (40) – lekarz prowadzący Barbarę.
SCENY: 13, 15, 17 – 3 sceny.
Wygląd: Około 40 lat, profesjonalny lekarz.
Szczegóły: Spokojny, rzeczowy, empatyczny. Dużo tekstu medycznego — aktor musi mówić go naturalnie i wiarygodnie.
📆26.10 

2.ADAM JABŁOŃSKI (27) – znajomy Jakuba z dawnego środowiska.
SCENY: 18, 19 OFF – 2 sceny.
Wygląd: Typ osiedlowego drobnego kombinatora, sportowy styl.
Szczegóły: Kusi Jakuba możliwością szybkiego, nielegalnego zarobku. W scenie 19 występuje wyłącznie głosem przez telefon.
📆27-28.10
📍z Wrocławia lub okolic 

3.JERZY NOWACZYK (57) – ojciec Jakuba.
SCENY: 20, 21 – 2 sceny.
Wygląd: Zaniedbany, zniszczony alkoholem mężczyzna.
Szczegóły: Manipulant i oportunista. Powinien początkowo sprawić wrażenie człowieka, który może rzeczywiście martwić się o Barbarę, aby późniejsze ujawnienie jego prawdziwych intencji zadziałało.
📆27-28.10
📍z Wrocławia lub okolic 

4.WALDEMAR MOREŃ (30) – biologiczny ojciec Julii, były mąż Doroty.
SCENY: 22, 23 – 2 sceny.
Wygląd: Dobrze ubrany 30-latek, pod którego normalnym wyglądem kryje się agresor.
Szczegóły: Podpity, agresywny i przemocowy. Musi być wiarygodnym zagrożeniem dla Doroty, ale zgodnie z charakterem pasma nie powinien być przerysowany.
📆26.10

5.PAWEŁ CICHOCKI (28 l.) – współlokator Edyty, później jej partner
SCENY: 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 18, 19, 22, 26, 27, 28
WYGLĄD: wysoki, postawny mężczyzna o charakterystycznej, nieco surowej aparycji. Może mieć dłuższe włosy i brodę. Na pierwszy rzut oka sprawia wrażenie niepokornego, szorstkiego i niedostępnego, jednak w rzeczywistości jest inteligentny, dowcipny, ciepły i wrażliwy. Pod twardą powierzchownością kryje się lojalny, opiekuńczy mężczyzna, który mimo trudnych doświadczeń potrafi kochać i walczyć o uczucie.
📆28-30.10
🎬 wymagane doświadczenie 

6.DAMIAN KRAWCZUK (32 l.) – były partner Edyty, mąż Pauliny
SCENY: 2, 10, 17 (OFF), 18, 20 INTRO: 1, 2
WYGLĄD: Przystojny, zadbany, elegancki mężczyzna po trzydziestce.
SZCZEGÓŁY: Szarmancki i przekonujący, ale manipulujący otoczeniem. Potrafi sprawiać wrażenie sympatycznego i wiarygodnego, jednocześnie kłamie i próbuje utrzymać kontrolę nad sytuacją.
📆28-29.10

7.ROMAN BARTOSZEK (58 l.) – ojciec Edyty
SCENY: 1, 4, 7 INTRO: 2
WYGLĄD: Siwiejący, zadbany mężczyzna przed sześćdziesiątką.
SZCZEGÓŁY: Rodzinny, bardziej powściągliwy od Haliny. Kocha córkę, ale po ujawnieniu romansu ma wobec niej wątpliwości i trudno mu zaakceptować sytuację.
📆29-30.10
📍z Wrocławia lub okolic

8.POŚREDNIK NIERUCHOMOŚCI (40 l.) – agent pokazujący Edycie mieszkanie
SCENA: 5
WYGLĄD: Zadbany, schludny, profesjonalny mężczyzna.
📆30.10
📍z Wrocławia lub okolic 

9.WIESŁAW NOWAK (55 l.) – właściciel mieszkania wynajmowanego przez Edytę i Pawła
SCENA: 9
WYGLĄD: Zwyczajny mężczyzna około 55 lat.
📆30.10
📍z Wrocławia lub okolic 

10.PIJAK (45 l.) – pijany mężczyzna zaczepiający Edytę
SCENA: 12
WYGLĄD: Zaniedbany mężczyzna około 45 lat.
SZCZEGÓŁY: Nachalny, nieprzyjemny i agresywny w zachowaniu; powinien wzbudzać poczucie zagrożenia.
📆29.10
📍z Wrocławia lub okolic 

11.PRZECHODZIEŃ (50 l.) – mieszkaniec osiedla
SCENA: 25
WYGLĄD: Zwyczajny mężczyzna około 50 lat.
📆28.10
📍z Wrocławia lub okolic 

📍Nagrania we Wrocławiu

🎬 Klik Film szuka osób i psów do nagrań wideo!

Szukamy naturalnych, fotogenicznych osób do sesji fotograficznej reklamowej i nagrań wideo timelapse do animacji dla naszego klienta. Sceny są proste i domowe, bez kwestii mówionych: praca przy biurku, pakowanie paczek, kolorowanie obrazków, wieszanie zdjęć na ścianie itp.

WARSZAWA, 4 listopada (środa)
Czas pracy na planie: ok. 4 h (pora dnia zależy od roli)

Stawka: 800 zł na rękę - rozliczenie na podstawie umowy o dzieło, płatne na koniec planu BLIKiem lub przelewem.

**Poszukujemy:**
* Kobieta, 25–30 lat: długie włosy, ciemny blond lub brąz, falowane lub kręcone
* Kobieta, ok. 40 lat: brunetka
* Mężczyzna, ok. 35 lat: brunet lub blondyn, wzrost ok. 180–185 cm
* Mężczyzna, 20–25 lat
* Dziewczynka, 5–6 lat: długie włosy (blond lub brąz)

U dorosłych prosimy o brak widocznych tatuaży (twarz, szyja, dłonie i przedramiona).

**Psy:**
* Para psów tej samej rasy i umaszczenia: szczeniak 3–4 miesiące i dorosły pies (od 9 miesięcy). Preferowane rasy: golden retriever, labrador, samoyed, goldendoodle lub inna rasa o jednolitym umaszczeniu.
* 1 Pies dowolnej rasy
* Psy (dorosłe) powinny znać podstawowe komendy i spokojnie wytrzymać chwilę w jednej pozycji. Opiekun lub treser musi być obecny na planie.

**Zgłoszenia:**
* Wskazanie roli do której aplikujecie
* Osoby dorosłe: min. jedno aktualne zdjęcie twarzy i jedno sylwetki oraz informacja, skąd jesteście.
* Dziewczynka: zgłasza rodzic lub opiekun, wysyłając te same zdjęcia.
* Psy: zdjęcia psa, rasa, wiek i informacja o umiejętnościach.

Prawa do wizerunku: 3 lata, Polska

Zgłoszenia prosimy wysyłać wyłącznie mailowo na adres: **casting@klikfilm.pl**

W tytule maila wpisz: **DRUKARKI WARSZAWA** Prosimy nie wysyłać wiadomości prywatnych, zgłoszenia przyjmujemy tylko mailowo, nie przeglądamy wiadomości na FB.

Do zobaczenia na planie!

Szukamy naturalnych, fotogenicznych osób do sesji fotograficznej reklamowej i nagrań wideo timelapse do animacji dla naszego klienta. Sceny są proste i domowe, bez kwestii mówionych: praca przy biurku, pakowanie paczek, kolorowanie obrazków, wieszanie zdjęć na ścianie itp.

WARSZAWA, 4 listopada (środa)
Czas pracy na planie: ok. 4 h (pora dnia zależy od roli)

Stawka: 800 zł na rękę - rozliczenie na podstawie umowy o dzieło, płatne na koniec planu BLIKiem lub przelewem.

**Poszukujemy:**
* Kobieta, 25–30 lat: długie włosy, ciemny blond lub brąz, falowane lub kręcone
* Kobieta, ok. 40 lat: brunetka
* Mężczyzna, ok. 35 lat: brunet lub blondyn, wzrost ok. 180–185 cm
* Mężczyzna, 20–25 lat
* Dziewczynka, 5–6 lat: długie włosy (blond lub brąz)

U dorosłych prosimy o brak widocznych tatuaży (twarz, szyja, dłonie i przedramiona).

**Psy:**
* Para psów tej samej rasy i umaszczenia: szczeniak 3–4 miesiące i dorosły pies (od 9 miesięcy). Preferowane rasy: golden retriever, labrador, samoyed, goldendoodle lub inna rasa o jednolitym umaszczeniu.
* 1 Pies dowolnej rasy
* Psy (dorosłe) powinny znać podstawowe komendy i spokojnie wytrzymać chwilę w jednej pozycji. Opiekun lub treser musi być obecny na planie.

**Zgłoszenia:**
* Wskazanie roli do której aplikujecie
* Osoby dorosłe: min. jedno aktualne zdjęcie twarzy i jedno sylwetki oraz informacja, skąd jesteście.
* Dziewczynka: zgłasza rodzic lub opiekun, wysyłając te same zdjęcia.
* Psy: zdjęcia psa, rasa, wiek i informacja o umiejętnościach.

Prawa do wizerunku: 3 lata, Polska

Zgłoszenia prosimy wysyłać wyłącznie mailowo na adres: **casting@klikfilm.pl**

W tytule maila wpisz: **DRUKARKI WARSZAWA** Prosimy nie wysyłać wiadomości prywatnych, zgłoszenia przyjmujemy tylko mailowo, nie przeglądamy wiadomości na FB.

Do zobaczenia na planie!

Zespół Klik Film

sharedPost.text:
Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, dein Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 43/2026

MOVIETIME IM DOPPELPACK

Zunächst gibt es um 17h ein Special inkl Interviews zum österreichischen Film. Unter anderem präsentiert Sarah Fuchs Ihnen Filme und Gespräche zu

Theresas Körper
Nachts in der Provinz 
Highway to Hofburg 

sowie weitere Filmtipps zum EU XXL Wanderkino im Weinviertel. 

Ab 18h startet dann die reguläre Ausgabe mit DER PERFEKTE URLAUB. Es handelt sich dabei um die offizielle Fortsetzung des mega Kino-Erfolgs „Das perfekte Geheimnis“ (2019), bei der erneut Erfolgsregisseur Bora Dagtekin für das Drehbuch und die Regie verantwortlich zeichnet.

Neben weiteren Filmtipps für die Kooperationskinos im Wald- und Weinviertel gibt es noch ein ausführliches Interview mit Alexander Mitterecker über ein spannendes Projekt.

Und last but not least die beste Musik aus den besten Filmen aller Zeiten.

Mittwoch 21.10.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

🎭 AUDITIONS ARE UNDERWAY! 🎭

Exciting things are happening at The Ensemble!

Our Acting for Adults class have been busy auditioning for our upcoming production of One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest, and we couldn’t be more excited to see this show coming together! 🎬

📸 Here’s a little behind-the-scenes look at some of our wonderful performers in action!

BUT DON’T PANIC… THERE’S STILL TIME TO GET INVOLVED! 👀

We still have spaces available for anyone who would love to join our acting company and be part of this fantastic production!

Whether you’re an experienced performer, looking to get back into acting, or fancy trying something completely new, we’d love to welcome you!

✨ No previous experience necessary
🎭 A friendly, supportive environment
🎬 The opportunity to perform in a full-scale production
❤️ Meet like-minded people who share a love of theatre!

📍 Peterborough
🎟️ Performances: 11th & 12th March 2027

Interested in joining us? Drop us a message to find out more!

Your next adventure on stage could be just around the corner! 🎭

#TheEnsemble #ActingForAdults #PeterboroughTheatre #OneFlewOverTheCuckoosNest #AdultActing #CommunityTheatre

SINGING LESSONS

My CLIENTS are on the WEST END right now, and I’ve been there too. Not many singing teachers can say that.
Credits include: Frozen, Evita, Cyrano de Bergerac, The King and I, Your Lie in April

The GOAL is to build unshakeable understanding that you can rely on, that’s technique.

**The Actor's Lab Online / Private Coaching for Actors**

**With 35+ years of experience in the Los Angeles market as an acting coach, mentor, and founder of The Actor’s Lab, I know what it takes to move an acting career forward. Talent is essential, but building a successful career requires more: the right guidance, a strategic approach, and a strong understanding of both the craft and the business of acting.**

**Through my private online coaching, I work one-on-one with actors to sharpen their skills, identify opportunities, overcome career challenges, and develop a focused strategy to take their careers to the next level.**

**My private coaching rate is $125 per hour.**

**I look forward to connecting with you.**

**J.D. Lewis **
**The Actor's Lab **
**(310) 621-3900**
**TheActorsLab@me.com**
**[www.TheActorsLab.com](https://www.TheActorsLab.com)**

✨ CASTING CALL: THE NORTH POLE EXPERIENCE ✨
FINAL SUBMISSIONS: PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN HEARING FROM:

👨 MALE IDENTIFYING ACTORS.
👩 FEMALE IDENTIFYING ACTOR/SINGERS
💡 LIGHTING / SOUND TECHNICIANS. 

Are you ready to bring the magic of Christmas to life? We are now accepting final submissions for dynamic, warm, and versatile performers for The North Pole Experience in Liverpool! (please note this is suggested for performers local to the North West UK area, travel / accommodation can not be provided). 

We are seeking performers of all genders (18+) for Principal, Supporting, and Operational roles across our festive attractions.

📍 Location: Liverpool (L17), United Kingdom

🎭 Roles: Male and Female identifying Scripted Principal Roles, Unscripted Supporting Roles & Immersive Operational Roles, Technical Roles. 

📆 Contract: Mid-November – Late December

What We’re Looking For
 * Principal Scripted Roles: Previous professional acting experience required.

 * Supporting & Operational Roles: Experience in entertainment or live performance is a plus, but enthusiastic newcomers with a passion for performing are welcome!

* Technical Roles: Lighting & Sound Technician. Experience operating within Chamsys MagicQ. Troubleshooting and problem solving in a fast paced environment. Must have previous professional experience within live events / theatre /. 

 * Personality: Strong, confident acting ability, natural stage warmth, and a true embodiment of the Christmas spirit.

📅 Key Dates (Full Availability Required)
 * Rehearsals: Select dates during week commencing 16th November. Role dependant.

 * Tech Rehearsals: 21st & 22nd November
 * Friends & Family Preview: 27th November
 * Opening weekend: 28th / 29th November 🎅
 * Charity Day: 2nd December (select characters only)
 * Show Days: 5th, 6th, 12th, 13th, 19th, 20th, 21st, 23rd & 24th December
 * Additional Performance Days (Otterspool Grotto - select characters only): 4th, 10th, 11th, 17th & 18th December.

Working hours operate on staggered start and finish times from 8:00am onwards, with finishes from 5:30pm onwards depending on character allocation. Cast members should be prepared for full-day shifts however certain days will have later starts and/or earlier finishes.

💰 Pay & Perks
 * Performance Days: Paid at up to £165 per day (depending on role and experience).
* Technical Roles: Pay discussed with each applicant. 

 * Rehearsal Days: Paid hourly at National Minimum Wage (NMW) for your age group.

 * Perks: Complimentary breakfast, lunch and refreshments provided on all performance days, free tickets for our Friends & Family Preview, plus staff discounts in our on-site merchandise shop.

📩 How to Apply
Please email casting@thenorthpoleexperience.co.uk with the following details:

 * Full Name & Contact Details (Phone number & email address)
 * Confirmation of Full Availability (Please note: We cannot consider applications with partial availability)
 * Relevant Performance/Entertainment Experience (if applicable)
 * Link to Spotlight / Showreel (Please do not attach large video files directly to the email)
 * Current Availability for In-Person Auditions

Help us bring the magic of Christmas to life — we can’t wait to make magic with you! ✨🎄.

www.thenorthpoleexperience.co.uk

items.text:
🎬 *CASTING CALL | THE NEST PROJECT* 🎬

*5 ACTORS REQUIRED - ADULT & CHILD ROLES*

With just four weeks of filming remaining on our current production, we are looking for *five new cast members* to join us for two upcoming filming dates.

🎭 *ROLES AVAILABLE*

*2 x Male Actors* - To portray fathers

*1 x Female Actor* - Supporting family role

*2 x Child Actors* - To portray siblings

These characters form part of a family who are close friends of Elara’s parents.

These are small but important supporting roles, *with some roles involving dialogue*. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain valuable on-set experience, work alongside a dedicated production team and receive an *IMDb credit for your role*. 

📅 *FILMING DATES*

*Friday 30th & Saturday 31st October 2026*

Applicants must be available on both dates.

📍 *FILMING LOCATION*

*Chester, Wirral or Manchester - TBC*

We are currently finalising the filming location, which will be confirmed with successful applicants as soon as arrangements are secured.

Applicants must be willing and able to travel to any of these locations.

🚨 *IMPORTANT CASTING REQUIREMENT*

We are specifically seeking *actors who have NOT previously filmed on this production*.

As we approach the final stages of filming, we would love to welcome some new faces to the project.

🎥 *ABOUT THE PRODUCTION*

*The Nest Project* is a *passion project*, brought to life by a dedicated cast and crew who share a genuine love for filmmaking and storytelling.

We believe in being completely transparent: *this is an unpaid production. No cast or crew members are receiving payment for their involvement.*

Everyone involved has generously contributed their time, talent and commitment to help bring this project to life.

With just *four weeks of filming remaining*, we are approaching the completion of a production built on teamwork, dedication and a shared creative vision.

🏆 *CANNES FILM FESTIVAL*

Following completion and post-production, our intention is to submit the finished film to the *Cannes Film Festival*.

This is an exciting goal for our team and something we are all working towards.

🎬 *FUTURE FILM OPPORTUNITIES*

*This project is only the beginning!*

We have *seven further films planned* with *paid opportunities for cast and crew* anticipated on future productions.

Although participation in this film does not guarantee future employment, it provides an excellent opportunity to gain experience, build industry connections and become part of our growing filmmaking network.

⭐ *WHAT YOU WILL GAIN*

* An *IMDb credit* for your role

* Valuable on-set filming experience

* The opportunity to work alongside a passionate and dedicated production team

* Industry networking and professional connections

* The opportunity to be considered for future projects, including potential paid roles

📩 *HOW TO APPLY*

Please email your *headshot or Spotlight profile*, along with:

* Your name and age

* The role you wish to be considered for

* Any previous acting experience (beginners welcome)

* Confirmation that you are available for *both 30th and 31st October*

* Confirmation that you can travel to Chester, Wirral or Manchester

📧 info@majesticacademyofperformingarts.co.uk 

Applications for child actors must be submitted by a parent or legal guardian.

📰 *READ OUR LATEST PRESS FEATURE*

Want to know more about the production and the journey behind *The Nest Project*?

Our latest feature in *MAXIT Magazine* provides further insight into the film, the creative vision and the passion driving this project forward.

*Summer-Joules Saunders Leads The Nest Project*

🔗 https://www.maxitmagazine.com/article/summer-joules-saunders-leads-the-nest-project

We encourage anyone interested in joining the production to read the article and learn more about what we are creating.

🎥 *We are looking for enthusiastic, reliable and committed individuals who would love to be part of this filmmaking journey.*

*One film nearing completion. Seven more productions ahead. A growing creative team with an exciting future.*

⭐ *Please share or tag anyone who may be interested!*

[Pozostało 6 wolnych miejsc]

**ĆWICZENIA Z WOLNOŚCI**

Zapraszam na moje pierwsze w Polsce regularne warsztaty treningowo-kreatywne dla osób aktorskich i performerskich zainteresowanych eksploracją warsztatu i własnego języka twórczego (cotygodniowe spotkania w Warszawie od listopada). 

Trening poprowadzi nas przez cztery etapy inspirowane podziałem Teatru Reduty — Zabawę, Przeżywanie, Przeistoczenie i Obrzędowość, a moduł eksploracji indywidualnej poetyki będzie oparty na zadaniach kreatywnych autorstwa hiszpańskiego twórcy Carlosa Tuñóna.

Chciałbym przede wszystkich dotrzeć do osób, które mają potrzebę rozwijać swój język twórczy i być inicjatorami autorskich projektów.

**PEŁNA INFORMACJA:**  [https://tomaszborczyk.pl/project/cwiczenia-z-wolnosci-warsztaty-roczne-2026-2027/](https://tomaszborczyk.pl/project/cwiczenia-z-wolnosci-warsztaty-roczne-2026-2027/)** **** **

Także w komentarzu pod postem.

📅 Start: 5 listopada 2026, czwartki 10:00–15:00
📍 ul. Tamka 40, Warszawa
💰 600 zł/miesiąc *
👥 12 miejsc (Pozostało 6) 

* Jeśli ktoś jest bardzo zainteresowany udziałem, ale cena jest dla niego/niej zbyt wysoka, proszę o kontakt. 

Termin zgłoszeń: 30 października 2026.

Prowadzi: Tomasz Borczyk, aktor i twórca teatralny (RESAD Madryt, dyrektor artystyczny kolektywu Noche de Camaleones, obecnie współpracujący z Instytutem Grotowskiego i Komuną Warszawa)

🎬 CASTING CALL — FEMALE LEAD FOR MUSIC VIDEO
📍 Location: Warsaw, Poland

Dates: 19.10-22.10 (estimate) 

Mystique Studios is casting a female lead, age 26–30, for an upcoming music video production to be filmed in Warsaw, Poland.

We are looking for a woman with:

• East European look

• Natural, innocent features

• Expressive face and comfortable presence in front of the camera

• Acting/modeling experience is welcome, but not essential

• Ability to portray natural emotion, warmth and chemistry on camera

🎥 ABOUT THE PROJECT

The music album has already been released, and we are now producing an official music video intended for YouTube, social media promotion and submission to music video/film festivals.

The shoot will take approximately 1–2 days in Warsaw, Poland.

This is an independent, low-budget production, so please apply with this in mind.

💰 COMPENSATION

This is a paid role, with cash payment depending on the selected cast member, experience and final shooting requirements.

Food, snacks and drinks will be provided during filming.

🎞️ ABOUT US

We are an independent, low-budget production studio focused on films, music and visual storytelling.

items.text:
CASTING CALL - Student Short Film
Looking for two lead actors (plays 19-early 20s) for a comedy short film shooting in late October/early November in the Twin Cities area.

LOGLINE

When two deadbeat teens run away to LA and their car breaks down, they decide to break into a local auto shop to steal expensive parts to fund the rest of their trip leading to a series of chaotic missteps. Think a classic Dumb and Dumber dynamic two suburban kids who act like they're way cooler and tougher than they actually are.

ROLES AVAILABLE

GUMMY (Lead | Plays 19-early 20s):

An airhead stoner and suburban kid who genuinely believes he's the ultimate mastermind and coolest guy in the room. Loud, overly assertive, and always shoots down better ideas with total unearned confidence.

Looking for strong energy and expressive comedic timing.

PENDEJO (Lead | Plays 19-early 20s):

A know-it-all stoner trying to act cool, but he's actually the slightly smarter one of the pair. Routinely gets steamrolled by Gummy and reluctantly goes along with Gummy's terrible plans anyway. Looking for strong deadpan delivery and physical comedy skills.

LIVE AUDITION DETAILS

When: Thursday, October 22nd @ 4:00 PM

Where: Century College East Campus, Room 1362

Format: In-person cold reads (sides provided at the door)

HOW TO AUDITION

Comment below, send a DM, or email rr3644er@go.minnstate.edu with:

1. ﻿﻿﻿Which role you're interested in (Gummy or Pendejo)

2. ﻿﻿﻿Your headshot / photo or a link to your reel (if you have one

3. ﻿﻿﻿Your general availability for shoot dates in late October / early November

Thanks for your interest <3

Think a classic Dumb and Dumber dynamic two suburban kids who act like they're way cooler and tougher than they actually are.

ROLES AVAILABLE

GUMMY (Lead | Plays 19-early 20s):

An airhead stoner and suburban kid who genuinely believes he's the ultimate mastermind and coolest guy in the room. Loud, overly assertive, and always shoots down better ideas with total unearned confidence.

Looking for strong energy and expressive comedic timing.

PENDEJO (Lead | Plays 19-early 20s):

A know-it-all stoner trying to act cool, but he's actually the slightly smarter one of the pair. Routinely gets steamrolled by Gummy and reluctantly goes along with Gummy's terrible plans anyway. Looking for strong deadpan delivery and physical comedy skills.

LIVE AUDITION DETAILS

When: Thursday, October 22nd @ 4:00 PM

Where: Century College East Campus, Room 1362

Format: In-person cold reads (sides provided at the door)

HOW TO AUDITION

Comment below, send a DM, or email rr3644er@go.minnstate.edu with:

1. ﻿﻿﻿Which role you're interested in (Gummy or Pendejo)

2. ﻿﻿﻿Your headshot / photo or a link to your reel (if you have one

3. ﻿﻿﻿Your general availability for shoot dates in late October / early November

Thanks for your interest <3

items.text:
CASTING CALL - PALM STONE
Casting four roles for Palm Stone, a nonunion student short film by Tafari Lewis.

A dedicated therapist keeps herself occupied with work and household routines as her clients’ stories begin to challenge her avoidance of her own grief.

SHOOT DETAILS

November 13-15, 2026 • Baltimore, Maryland
Three-day production. Individual actors’ required days will depend on their role. No rehearsals are currently planned.

COMPENSATION

Unpaid. Meals, screen credit, and footage for acting reels will be provided. Travel reimbursement may be discussed depending on distance and available budget.

ROLES
JENNIFER - Lead, woman, playing late thirties. Open ethnicity.

An intelligent and caring therapist who maintains a composed exterior while keeping difficult emotions buried beneath constant activity. Her warmth and dry humor show heavily at home.

Seeking a performer comfortable conveying emotional shifts through quiet reactions and moments of silence.

JACK - Supporting, man, playing late thirties. Open ethnicity.

Jennifer’s husband. Warm, playful, and loves baseball, Jack brings familiar teasing and easy affection to their relationship.

Seeking natural chemistry with Jennifer. The role includes potential hugging and cuddling; no kissing or nudity.

SARAH - Supporting, adult woman; age flexible. Open ethnicity.

A grieving client who finds unexpected comfort in a memory of her partner. Exhausted but capable of warmth and humor, Sarah shares an experience that deeply affects Jennifer. Seeking an honest, understated performance.

DIANE - Voice-only supporting role, adult woman; playing age flexible. Open ethnicity.

Jack’s mother who continues reaching out despite unanswered calls. Her voice carries familiarity and emotional warmth. Recording arrangements will be discussed with selected applicants.

HOW TO APPLY

Submit your headshot, résumé, acting reel, and availability for November 13–15 through the Google Form:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSds4RfIUGX6G-V-l5qk9cZuDP1EIjcq7vwU8bUENdIzPAuSYw/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=100122457934176448465

Selected applicants will be invited to submit self-tape auditions.

items.text:
Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Web Series
Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.1 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline ASAP.

Link to my Series on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5A8Ih2U1y15yAfFecmlZ4q_QsdmDLCXT&si=zU8XrRNGpXokHSDY

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

Søges: Kvinder i alle aldre i hele landet til at mime med kort musikvideo/ reel 🎬✨
I forbindelse med udgivelsen af mit debutalbum A Woman’s Heart i november, søger jeg kvinder i alle aldre i hele landet til et et kort klip til en reel!

Hvad går det ud på?

Du skal blot filme en kort selfie-video (tæt på ansigtet), hvor du mimer med på omkvædet (musikken bliver lagt på bagefter) – enten med et stort smil, et fjollet udtryk eller bare ren god energi. Sangen handler nemlig om at slippe sig fri som kvinde, og omkvædet er supernemt at lære! 

Tanken er mange korte klip fra mange forskellige kvinder, så man ser dig højst sandsynligt kun i et par sekunder. ☺️

Det praktiske:

• Du filmer det selv derhjemme - burde ikke tage mere end 15 min. 

• Honorar: Der er et lille symbolsk honorar for din tid, da det også er en lille opgave og min økonomi ikke er så stor endnu. 

Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, så send mig en besked - så sender jeg sangen og mere info! ☺️

topComments.text: Helle Dahl det kan du også. 😊🤩

🎙️ OD KURSU DUBBINGOWO-LEKTORSKIEGO DO WŁASNEGO SŁUCHOWISKA!

Kiedy nauka przeradza się w pasję, apetyt na kolejne wyzwania tylko rośnie! 🎭

Za nami dwudniowy Masterclass „Słuchowisko” w Lublinie, podczas którego nasi absolwenci zmierzyli się z kolejnym aktorskim wyzwaniem: realizacją autorskiego słuchowiska „Pięcioro”.

Od pracy nad scenariuszem i budowania postaci, aż po nagrania w profesjonalnym studiu. Emocje, interpretacja, współpraca i przede wszystkim praktyka! 🎧

🎬 A efekty naszej pracy usłyszycie już niebawem! Premiera słuchowiska „Pięcioro” jeszcze pod koniec października! 🎙️

Bo właśnie na praktyce opieramy również nasz roczny Kurs Dubbingowo-Lektorski. Uczymy świadomej pracy głosem, interpretacji tekstu, dubbingu i lektorstwa, a zdobyte umiejętności przekładamy na konkretne doświadczenie przed mikrofonem.

🎙️ Chcesz spróbować swoich sił w dubbingu i lektorstwie? Dołącz do naszego kursu w Lublinie!

📍 Lublin, Krakowskie Przedmieście 39
🎭 Prowadzące: Izabela Markiewicz- Strona Aktorki i Wokalistki  i  Małgorzata Neczyperowicz - aktorka 
🎧 Zajęcia praktyczne, konsultacje indywidualne i profesjonalne demo głosowe na zakończenie kursu.

📲 Zapisy na stronie kursów. Link w bio🙂
📞 720 806 806

#KursyAktorskie #Masterclass #Słuchowisko #Dubbing #KursDubbingowoLektorski

Jestem Claude Degas, robię muzykę i pomyślałem, że zostawię się tutaj na wypadek, gdyby komuś z Was przydało się coś dźwiękowego do filmu, krótkiego metrażu, animacji czy jakiegoś dziwnego projektu, który jeszcze nie wie, czym chce być.

Robię swoje rzeczy, trochę różne od siebie, bo nie lubię zamykać się w jednym gatunku ani jednym klimacie. Jest elektronika, bas, techno, są też bardziej emocjonalne i nieoczywiste rzeczy.

Jeśli szukacie muzyki do swojego filmu, chętnie udostępnię dowolny utwór ze swojej dyskografii na SoundCloud

Nie trzeba mieć gotowego pomysłu ani wielkiego projektu. Po prostu piszcie, podeślę coś pod konkretny klimat albo możecie przekopać cały profil.

VANCOUVER CASTING CALL — TWO FEMALE ROLES
We’re seeking two performers who can portray teenage girls, ages 13–19, for an independent short film exploring social issues affecting women. Adults who can convincingly play teens are welcome to apply.

Role 1: Open to all ethnicities

Role 2: Seeking an Indigenous performer

We’re looking for a natural presence and emotional depth. No acting experience or demo reel is required. Please send a short, makeup-free video introducing yourself.

Location: Vancouver

Filming: Two days in early November

Compensation: Unpaid portfolio project. Meals provided on both days.

The film is led by a female director, with a crew of Vancouver Film School graduates currently working in the industry. The director’s previous short received selections and awards across four film festivals in London and the United States. We plan to submit this film to more than 50 festivals.

Please send your introduction video and availability to hiayj23@gmail.com.

Thank you for your interest. Sharing this casting call is appreciated.

🎭 THERE’S STILL ROOM FOR YOU IN THE CRUCIBLE! ❤️

Come be part of something meaningful!
Our auditions are almost full, but there are still so many ways to get involved in our exciting community theatre production of The Crucible, coming to Ottawa’s Gladstone Theatre in February 2027!
Whether you’ve never set foot in a theatre or have years of professional experience, we’d love to hear from you!
No experience necessary! And to those with experience, knowledge, and expertise to share, your volunteer contributions would be enormously valued.
We also believe this experience has something wonderful to offer everyone who participates.

❤️ MORE THAN A PLAY
Arthur Miller wrote The Crucible in 1953 as a parable for McCarthyism and the fear, accusations, and political persecution of his time.
We believe it can also serve as a powerful parable for the times we’re living in today.
Through this production, we’ll explore questions about fear, power, conformity, courage, conscience, and what happens when communities turn against one another.
We’re not here to tell people what to think. We’re creating space to think, question, discuss, and explore together.
And, of course, to create some wonderful theatre along the way!

🌟 HOW CAN YOU GET INVOLVED?
🎭 Onstage: Non-speaking roles, ensemble performers, and understudies.

🎨 Creative & Technical: Sets, props, costumes, construction, painting, hair and makeup, lighting, sound, and backstage crew.

🎬 Production Support: Stage management, rehearsal assistance, volunteer coordination, transportation, logistics, photography, and video.

📣 Marketing & Community: Social media, postering, publicity, creating our online program, finding sponsors, connecting with local TV, radio, newspapers and podcasts, and community outreach.

❤️ Special Opportunities: Helping organize our intergenerational performance for seniors and high school students, supporting special lobby activities, accessibility and participant support, and other helping hands!

Have a talent or idea we haven’t mentioned? Tell us!

📅 COME MEET US!
Tuesday, October 20 at 6:00 p.m.

📍 All Saints Westboro
347 Richmond Road, Ottawa
This is an opportunity for people interested in non-speaking roles and behind-the-scenes involvement to meet us and learn more about the production.

Please email us in advance to let us know you’re coming. No drop-ins, please!

💌 connect@nataliefraser.ca
Include your name, phone number, areas of interest, any experience or skills you’d like to share, your general availability, and whether you’ll attend October 20.

Can’t make October 20? That’s absolutely fine! Email us anyway, and we’ll invite you to join us on November 1.
🗓️ WHAT ABOUT THE COMMITMENT?
Rehearsals will generally take place on Wednesdays and Sundays, but not everyone will be needed every week. There will also be some full-cast and crew days, with details shared as we develop the rehearsal schedule.

❤️ WHY BE PART OF IT?
Because community theatre is about more than putting on a show.
It’s about people of different ages, backgrounds, and experiences coming together. Sharing skills. Learning new things. Building friendships. Challenging ourselves. Having fun. And creating something that matters.
Whether you come to learn, to share your expertise, to meet new people, or because the themes of this play speak to you, we hope you’ll find something meaningful in the experience too.
The Crucible was a parable for Miller’s time. What might it reveal about ours?
Let’s explore that together!

🎭 THE CRUCIBLE
February 17–20, 2027
The Gladstone Theatre, Ottawa
Unedited Woman Productions
Come for the theatre. Stay for the community. Be part of the conversation. ❤️

#TheCrucible #OttawaTheatre #CommunityTheatre #OttawaVolunteers #UneditedWomanProductions #TheGladstone #VolunteerOttawa

sharedPost.text:
Natura oferă Resursa, iar OMUL este chemat să adauge grijă, cunoaștere, respect și responsabilitate. Întrebarea este dacă știm să facem acest lucru!

Alături de un om special, domnul Silviu Manole, Președintele Clusterului Regional de Economie Circulară Agrofood, Director al Fabricii de Imbuteliere a Apei Minerale Vâlcele, înțelegem ce înseamnă balneologia nu doar ca practică medicală, ci ca idee despre relația dintre om și loc. 
Un loc în care mediul natural, mediul construit, sănătatea, cultura și comunitatea se susțin reciproc.

Au existat vremuri în care statiunile balneare erau mai mult decat destinatii de tratament. Erau locuri construite in jurul unei idei simple si puternice: Omul se poate reface atunci cand natura, sanatatea si viata comunitatii sunt in echilibru!

Apa minerala, aerul curat, padurea, linistea, lumina, miscarea, promenada, parcul, arhitectura, intalnirea cu ceilalti si ritmul cotidian faceau parte din aceeasi experienta. 
Statiunea nu trata doar corpul, ci crea un mediu care sustinea starea de bine, echilibrul interior si forta vitala.

Astazi, multe dintre aceste locuri si-au pierdut coerenta. Unele cladiri sunt abandonate, unele infrastructuri au disparut, precum Baza de Tratament de la Vâlcele, în urma unui incendiu, iar in multe cazuri, dezvoltarea s-a facut fragmentat, fara o imagine de ansamblu si fara suficienta grija fata de caracterul locului. 

Si Totusi...Esenta acestor statiuni nu a disparut!

Doza de Alinare e cea care investigheaza din pasiune aceste aspecte! Si daca ducem un mesaj util mai departe in comunitate, ne consideram norocosi! Dati un click mai jos sa va familiarizati!

LADbible Castings:

1. Looking for genuine students who are currently studying at any University in Oxford for a fun shoot where you'll answer quiz questions about science to try and win free Dominos pizza. 29th of October in Oxford, £250 payment.
2. Looking for people with the surname Little, Littler or any variation of the 'Little' name for a wholesome Christmas campaign. Shooting in London on 19th November. £300 payment.
3. Looking for someone to nominate a community hero (could be a fireperson, frontline worker, someone very deserving) for a wholesome surprise shoot. Shooting in London on 30th November. £500 payment per person involved.
4. Looking for a someone who has a partner who does shift work and usually works a lot over the Christmas period to nominate them for a lovely surprise. Would be better if the family also has children so the group can be involved. Shooting 12th November, can be flexible on location. £300 payment for each person involved
5. Looking for a hilarious granny or grandad with a natural comedy flair who can film with their grown up grandkids and surprise them with some 'Gen Alpha' slang. Shooting in London on 26th November. £2000 payment for whole family.

If interested in any of these castings please drop me an email to erica.stein@ladbiblegroup.com letting me know which one and I will forward more information. Thanks!

🎬 KRAKÓW POSZUKUJEMY KOSTIUMOGRAFA/FKI DO FILMU DYPLOMOWEGO  

 

Do realizacji filmu krótkometrażowego, dyplomowego poszukujemy osoby, która podejmie się współtworzenia wizualnej strony naszej produkcji. Zdjęcia są zaplanowane na przełom listopada i grudnia.

 

Szukamy osoby z wyczuciem estetycznym, kreatywnością i umiejętnością opowiadania historii poprzez kostium. Zależy nam na współpracy przy tworzeniu koncepcji kostiumograficznej dopasowanej do świata przedstawionego, postaci i atmosfery filmu.

 

Oczekujemy kreatywnego podejścia i zaangażowania.

Mile widziane doświadczenie przy produkcjach filmowych lub teatralnych.

 

Oferujemy możliwość współtworzenia niezależnego projektu filmowego, rozwijania własnych pomysłów i współpracy z ekipą filmową.

 

📩 Osoby zainteresowane prosimy o przesłanie krótkiego portfolio lub informacji o dotychczasowych realizacjach oraz kilku słów o sobie na adres: **marzena.casting@gmail.com**

 

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: „Kostiumograf – dyplom”.

রেঙে উঠেছে মহানবমীর নিশি। জনপ্লাবিত কল্লোলিনী।

তারই মধ্যে সন্ধান চালাচ্ছি হটী বিদ্যালংকারের। ১৭ শতকের সেই বিদুষী বিদ্রোহিনীকে এই দেবীপক্ষে আবিষ্কার করতেই হবে।

আজ পৌঁছে গেছি অধ্যাপক, অভিনেতা শ্রীমতী সেঁজুতি 'হটী' মুখোপাধ্যায়ের চৌকাঠে। 

The night of Maha Navami is aglow. The bustling metropolis — Kallolini — is flooded with people.

And amidst it all, I am searching for HOTI VIDYALANKAR. That erudite, rebellious woman scholar of the 17th century must be discovered in this Devi Paksha.

Today, I have arrived at the doorstep of professor and actor, Smt. Senjuti 'HOTI' Mukhopadhyay.

🎃 THIS HALLOWEEN, DARKNESS RUNS DEEP IN TEXAS. 🌑

Sometimes revenge is not always a choice.

Can a man escape his past when his past refuses to let him go?

Manipulation. Obsession. Addiction. Violence.

Enter the disturbing world of BLIND BLOOD, the award-winning Texas psychological crime thriller where a sociopath and a psychopath collide—and the darkest side of human nature takes over.

▶️ WATCH THE OFFICIAL TEASER.

💥 Blind Blood — Now Streaming 💥

Available in the 🇺🇸 US, 🇨🇦 Canada, 🇲🇽 Mexico, 🇬🇧 UK & 🇦🇺 Australia.

items.text:
🎬 KRAKÓW POSZUKUJEMY KOSTIUMOGRAFA/FKI DO FILMU DYPLOMOWEGO  

 

Do realizacji filmu krótkometrażowego, dyplomowego poszukujemy osoby, która podejmie się współtworzenia wizualnej strony naszej produkcji. Zdjęcia są zaplanowane na przełom listopada i grudnia.

 

Szukamy osoby z wyczuciem estetycznym, kreatywnością i umiejętnością opowiadania historii poprzez kostium. Zależy nam na współpracy przy tworzeniu koncepcji kostiumograficznej dopasowanej do świata przedstawionego, postaci i atmosfery filmu.

 

Oczekujemy kreatywnego podejścia i zaangażowania.

Mile widziane doświadczenie przy produkcjach filmowych lub teatralnych.

 

Oferujemy możliwość współtworzenia niezależnego projektu filmowego, rozwijania własnych pomysłów i współpracy z ekipą filmową.

 

📩 Osoby zainteresowane prosimy o przesłanie krótkiego portfolio lub informacji o dotychczasowych realizacjach oraz kilku słów o sobie na adres: **marzena.casting@gmail.com**

 

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: „Kostiumograf – dyplom”.

Call for Participants: Staged Reading Theatre Workshop

Are you an aspiring or experienced actor with lived experience of addiction?

“Saving the Timothy” — A Modern Retelling of “A Christmas Carol”

The Recovered Arts Collective is seeking actors for an upcoming staged reading of Saving the Timothy, a new dramatic comedy written and directed by John-David Hutchison.

We also require Stage Manager, Assistant Director, Lighting & Sound Technicians

About the Project
We are bringing together a community of people with lived experience of addiction to participate in developing this new play. This project will culminate in a staged reading—a live performance where actors read the script with minimal sets, props, or costumes. Performers focus on character development, vocal expression, and text interpretation in a supportive, low-pressure environment.

Logline
A washed-up, addiction-ravaged Hollywood director returns to his small-town Canadian theatre roots to stage A Christmas Carol, where the specter of his late partner forces him through a dark, hallucinatory journey across his past, present, and future toward 12-step redemption and sobriety.

Who Can Join & What to Expect
Inclusive Community: Everyone is welcome! Whether you are a seasoned creative or have never stepped foot on a stage before, no previous experience is required—just a willingness to share your story and connect.

Supportive Environment: A peer-led space focused on safety, creative expression, personal growth, and building lasting relationships.

Collaborative Process: Work together to bring personal and community stories to life, culminating in a public staged reading performance.

Key Dates & Location
Audition / Table Read: Sunday, November 1, 2026, 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Rehearsals: Sundays (November 8, 15, 22, 29), 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Performance: Sunday, December 6, 2026 (Time TBD)
Location: The Vancouver Recovery Club, 2775 Sophia St, Vancouver, BC

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Character Breakdown
Eban Miser: A once-prominent Broadway and Hollywood director who, after facing bankruptcy, career failure, and struggles with alcoholism and drug addiction, returns to his hometown to direct a local production of A Christmas Carol and undergoes a redemptive journey toward sobriety.

Jake O'Connor/The Ghost of Christmas Future: Eban's late business partner and co-founder of the Timothy Findley Theatre, who dies broke and unaccomplished, but happy and whose reanimated corpse warns Eban to change his destructive path.

Bob Cratchit: Eban's loyal and hardworking stage manager at the theatre, who later becomes an equal partner and helps care for Timothia.

Fred: Eban's cheerful and persistent nephew who repeatedly invites him to holiday gatherings and tries to show him goodwill.

Clara: Fred's wife and member of the theatre troupe

Bill (The Ghost of Christmas Past): A calm, guiding figure who leads Eban through his spectral journey 

Fan: Eban's late sister.

Mr. Fezziwig: Eban's enthusiastic high school gym teacher who features in his past memory of a school dance.

Patricia: Eban's former fiancée who broke off their relationship because he abandoned their shared values for the pursuit of wealth.

Belle: Eban's former partner who left him because of his unaddressed alcoholism.

Emily: Bob Cratchit's sharp-tongued wife who helps run the household and cares for Timothia.

Timothia: Jake’s sullen 15-year-old orphaned daughter who lives with Bob and Emily.

Jack: The abusive stepfather from Eban's childhood.

Craig: Belle's husband.

Nancy, Topper, and Friends: Members of the theatre troupe
Roastmaster and 3 Roast Comics: Roasters of Eban (These four roles are specifically for comedians who will assist in the writing of the roast dialogue.)

This is a volunteer opportunity and you must be committed to the rehearsal schedule.

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Casting selection will be through the table read.

Questions? Reach out to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org with the subject line "Staged Reading Inquiry."

Jigsaw Casting is seeking Canadian User -generated videos that show a ‘winning moment’ in life for a LOTTO 649 campaign done through TBWA\Canada (address: 219 Dufferin Street, Suite 302C, Toronto, ON, M6K 3J1/Tel: 416.483.3600/[https://tbwa.ca/](https://tbwa.ca/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFaZzlmNFdiS1JOMTRibVNkc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHifDGia4LsOANDG_Ih2ltQT9AaeTz2u2uhuNe4hNlIgkWLvv1Kcxh0Qp2M2Z_aem_X_R1CiZkB1duyws1Eg9Ziw)) (Excludes submissions from the province of Quebec)

We are looking for those moments that feel like someone is coming out on top. Your video clips should have a range of emotions. Some are fist pumping celebrations (i.e. catching a baseball). Others are beautiful, heartfelt moments (i.e. someone asking out his crush and getting her number, or someone getting married and it was a very emotional romantic moment).

We’ll prioritize a broad range of Canadian experiences and affinities, from fishing and outdoor activities to sports, city moments, friendships, family and romantic relationships.

Canadian-shot content only: All footage must be filmed in Canada. Canadian creators are preferred, and recognizable non-Canadian locations/backdrops should be avoided. Generic footage from a Canadian creator that does not reveal an identifiable foreign location may be considered subject to client approval.

What we are looking for:

Our clips also fall into two camps: The Win and The Agency.

The Win
This shows the moment people come out on top.
For example:
→ Pulling a giant trout from the water
→ Catching a home run baseball in the stands

The Agency
This shows a moment of doubt, hesitation, or choice.
→ A moment before their hole-in-one swing, a friend saying they can’t make the shot.
→ Someone getting egged on before they go on stage and slay at karaoke.
→ Someone is deliberating doing that cliff dive. Do they vs don’t they.

If you have another footage that is a wild card, it may not fit the above specs, you can still submit it.

The selected videos would be used for our LOTTO 649 campaign. This is a non-union project. If your video is chosen, you will be paid $2,500.00 per video.

Permissions:
Submitted videos must have been shot prior to October 14, 2026.
The person who has filmed the video has granted permission for the video to appear in the ad on TV and online.
All talent who appears in the video are cleared and grant permission for the video to be used

Here’s a top line of things to avoid:
No one under 25 and no children of any age in the video clips.
Nothing that could be perceived as appealing to children. This is a bit nebulous, we know, so use your best judgement.
Nothing that comes across as specifically American.
No alcohol is shown in the clip.

Submissions are due ASAP or before: October 28 at 11am EST.

If interested, you must upload your video(s)to be considered to:
https://lotto649ugc.castingcrane.com/

items.text:
🎬 LITTLE STARS: Getting Your Kids Into Acting & Modeling

⭐ PART 3: Our First Day on Set!

The girls were 15 months old when we headed to their first acting job! Two busy toddlers, a drive from San Diego to outside LA, and a whole new experience for all of us. 😂

Their first shoot was only about an hour and a half, and they did great! Everyone was so nice, which made the experience feel a lot less intimidating. ❤️

Thinking about doing this with your little one? Here are a few things to know!

🧳 OVERPACK!

I've heard plenty of stories about fussy babies and parents who weren't prepared. Bring more diapers, wipes, extra clothes, snacks, food, and feeding supplies than you think you'll need. Pack favorite comfort items, books, and plenty of different toys to keep them occupied.

🚪 Be prepared to wait!

You may be sitting in a small room for hours before your child is needed. Plan for keeping your baby or toddler comfortable, fed, and entertained during that waiting time. This is where all that extra stuff comes in handy!

⏰ Know their legal work limits!

Here in California, the standard entertainment industry limits per day are:

👶 15 days to under 6 months: Up to 2 hours at the work location, with no more than 20 minutes of actual work.

👶 6 months to under 2 years: Up to 4 hours at the work location, with no more than 2 hours of actual work.

🧒 2 years to under 6 years: Up to 6 hours at the work location, with no more than 3 hours of actual work.

Remember, time at the studio and time actually working are two different things! The remaining permitted time includes rest, recreation, and education where applicable. These are California rules, and other states may differ.

🚗 Factor in the drive!

A short shoot can still turn into a VERY long day when you're traveling from another city. Think about meals, naps, traffic, and the trip home. There is a lot more involved than just showing up for an hour or two if you have to commute. 

❤️ Your child's needs come first!

They're still babies and toddlers, even when they've booked a job! Stay flexible, pay attention to their needs, and don't be afraid to speak up.

That first booking was only supposed to be for one episode, and that was just the beginning! 🥹

💰 COMING NEXT — PART 4: Let's Talk MONEY!

How much do kids actually make? What do agents take? What about travel expenses? And is it even worth it financially?

I'll be breaking down the money side of child acting, including some of our own experiences!

What would YOU want to know before taking your child to their first acting job? 👇

Follow along for Part 4! 🎬❤️

#LittleStars #ChildActing #BabyActors #ToddlerActors #KidsInEntertainment #ChildModeling #MomLife

Remember, time at the studio and time actually working are two different things! The remaining permitted time includes rest, recreation, and education where applicable. These are California rules, and other states may differ.

🚗 Factor in the drive!

A short shoot can still turn into a VERY long day when you're traveling from another city. Think about meals, naps, traffic, and the trip home. There is a lot more involved than just showing up for an hour or two if you have to commute. 

❤️ Your child's needs come first!

They're still babies and toddlers, even when they've booked a job! Stay flexible, pay attention to their needs, and don't be afraid to speak up.

That first booking was only supposed to be for one episode, and that was just the beginning! 🥹

💰 COMING NEXT — PART 4: Let's Talk MONEY!

How much do kids actually make? What do agents take? What about travel expenses? And is it even worth it financially?

I'll be breaking down the money side of child acting, including some of our own experiences!

What would YOU want to know before taking your child to their first acting job? 👇

Follow along for Part 4! 🎬❤️

⏰ Call Time: 12:00 PM

We can’t wait to create something amazing together. Please share with anyone who might be interested! 💫

***Only 12 spots left for auditions on Tuesday!***

**CASTING NOTICE**

Non-Equity Call; $50/performance

Trinity Theatre Company is seeking actors to fill all roles for *POTUS* by Selina Fillinger, directed by Kandace Crystal and performing January 8-17, 2027. Also seeking actors to fill most roles in the world premier of The House Between by Serhat Pala, directed by Sean Boyd and performing February 26 - March 14, 2027.

**Auditions:** In-Person appointments on October 20th. Please prepare a 1-2 minute monologue of your choice. Submissions are being taken online through [Sign Up Genius](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions). All submissions must be submitted through this platform. ([https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions))

Prior to auditions, you will be emailed to submit a *digital *copy of your headshot & resume. Hard copies are not required, and will not be taken.

**Important Dates for *****POTUS***:

December 1 – First Rehearsal

December 29 - January 7 – Tech

January 8 - January 17 – Performances

****Break for Christmas Week and New Year Holidays****

**Important Dates for *****The House Between***:

January 12 – First Rehearsal

February 16-25 – Tech

February 26 - March 14 – Performances

**Location:**

All Rehearsals & Performances will take place at the Trinity Theatre Company, 9520 Padgett Street, Suite 208, San Diego, CA 92126

Rehearsals Tuesdays - Fridays from 6p-10p.

Performances Fridays & Saturdays at 7p; Sundays at 2p.

**Character Breakdown:**

****Actors of all ethnicities, race, age, and gender are encouraged to apply****

POTUS:

HARRIET - His Chief of Staff

JEAN - His press secretary

STEPHANIE - His secretary

DUSTY - His dalliance

BERNADETTE - His sister

CHRIS - A journalist

MARGARET - His wife. The First Lady.

THE HOUSE BETWEEN:

CHRISSY -Greek–Australian. 50s–60s.

A painter and mother living in Melbourne. Warm, witty, and emotionally brave beneath a practiced competence. Carries the “unfinished story” of her grandfather and a restless need to stand inside the place it began.

JOHN -Chrissy’s son. Late 20s–30s.

Protective, skeptical, articulate. Thinks structurally (risk, logistics, consequences). His love often arrives as interrogation first, tenderness second.

ATHENA -Chrissy’s daughter. 20s

Bright, affectionate, and perceptive. The first to offer warmth, the quickest to name what’s happening in the room; often the bridge between generations.

HAKAN -Turkish–American. 50s–60s.

An academic (a professor). Disciplined, cerebral, private; until the right silence breaks him open. He’s spent a lifetime explaining history; now he has to live inside it. His emotional center is steadier than he expects.

ARDA - THIS ROLE HAS BEEN CAST - Hakan’s son. 20s.

Startup founder building AI; ambitious, fast, sincere. Wants speed and scale, but still shows up when family becomes real. Capable of surprising gentleness. Special connection to father, almost the Hakan that could have been.

SAM -Hakan’s longtime friend. 50s–60s.

Semi-retired executive / mentor type. Warm, dry, and socially fluent; he can defuse tension without minimizing it. A steady witness - sometimes a referee, sometimes a catalyst.

IRFAN -Local fixer/contractor/paperwork operator. 40s–50s.

An indispensable “solver” who sells solutions and then invents them. Big-hearted, opportunistic, funny without being a clown. Carries a tape measure like a sword. Wants to be essential (and paid). Often the play’s pressure-valve, but with real stakes underneath. Not meant to be a cartoonish character with more substance than quickly visible on the surface.

METIN - Local falcon enthusiast / informal guide. Age flexible (30s–70s).

Arrives with tea and an overstuffed “logbook” energy. Speaks in folk-poetic metaphor that lands more deeply than he intends. Slightly mystical, slightly practical, like the town itself.

*About the Shows:*

***POTUS - ***One four-letter word is about to rock 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue. When the President unwittingly spins a PR nightmare into a global crisis, the seven brilliant and beleaguered women he relies upon most risk life, liberty, and the pursuit of sanity to keep the commander-in-chief out of trouble.

***The House Between ***- “The House Between” is about two immigrants drawn to the same ruined house from opposite histories. Chrissy, a Greek-Australian artist, and Hakan, a Turkish-American historian, meet in Ayvalık, Türkiye, and begin a late-in-life love story shaped by memory, family, and displacement. The play asks: when you carry more than one home inside you, how do you choose where you belong?
